title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Deepfake pornography using the faces of Dutch public figures was deployed on a platform with millions of monthly visitors. The system enabled creation and distribution of non-consensual sexual imagery by providing uploaders anonymity and financial incentive through views. This is a failure to prevent impersonation and sexual abuse through synthetic media.

The deployment required no human review of content before it reached an audience. The platform's design actively shielded creators from accountability while monetizing harm. Catching this failure would have required either content moderation before publication or identity verification of uploaders, either of which would have made the abuse considerably harder.

Whether the platform operator knew these videos were being created, or intended the anonymity feature to enable abuse, is not established by the reporting.

summary:
Multiple female Dutch celebrities are considering legal action after discovering manipulated pornographic videos featuring their faces on an online platform that receives approximately 13 million monthly visitors. The videos include Dutch entertainers, television presenters, Olympic athletes, current and former politicians, mayors, and members of the Royal Family. Justice Minister Yesilgöz called the videos disgusting and encouraged victims to file police reports. Several victims' representatives confirmed to news sources that they have filed complaints or are exploring legal options.

Deepfake pornography falls under revenge porn laws and is therefore criminal. Users who upload material to the platform receive anonymity to avoid prosecution and earn money when videos gain views. Legal experts advise victims to file police reports, which may allow authorities to shut down the website. Other remedies available to victims include launching class action lawsuits, filing complaints with data protection authorities, or contacting hosting companies. Previously, television presenter Welmoed Sijtsma successfully pursued a case against a man from Amersfoort who created fake pornographic videos of her, resulting in his conditional sentence of 180 hours in 2023.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
